SELECT rg.name AS region, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = cu.region_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY rg.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-04-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-07-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_count
FROM orders od
WHERE od.status = 'cancelled' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-10-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT pr.category AS category, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = li.product_id
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY pr.category
ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT rg.name AS region,
       COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS services_revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = li.product_id
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = li.product_id
WHERE pr.category = 'services' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-02-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-02-01'
GROUP BY rg.name

SELECT COUNT(*) AS soft_deleted_count
FROM orders od
WHERE od.deleted_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT rg.name AS region, COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS net_revenue_cents
FROM regions rg
JOIN customers cu ON cu.region_id = rg.region_id
JOIN orders od ON od.customer_id = cu.customer_id AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
JOIN order_lines li ON li.order_id = od.order_id
WHERE rg.name = 'APAC'
GROUP BY rg.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS order_value_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-08-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-09-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS gross_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
  AND li.product_id IN (SELECT pr.product_id FROM products pr WHERE pr.category = 'hardware')

SELECT cu.name AS customer, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers cu
JOIN orders od ON od.customer_id = cu.customer_id AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
JOIN order_lines li ON li.order_id = od.order_id
GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.name
ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 'FQ2' AS fiscal_quarter,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS x
        FROM order_lines li
        JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
        WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-04-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-07-01') AS revenue_cents
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FQ3',
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS x
        FROM order_lines li
        JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
        WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01')

WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT od.order_id,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) FROM order_lines li WHERE li.order_id = od.order_id) AS total_cents
  FROM orders od
  WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
)
SELECT AVG(total_cents) AS avg_revenue_cents FROM per_order

SELECT cu.name AS customer, COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers cu
JOIN orders od ON od.customer_id = cu.customer_id AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
JOIN order_lines li ON li.order_id = od.order_id
WHERE cu.name = 'Rhine Goods'
GROUP BY cu.name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT od.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM orders od
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS q3_revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = cu.region_id
WHERE rg.name = 'EMEA' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT rg.name AS region, SUM(li.qty) AS units
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = li.product_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY rg.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-09-01'

SELECT cu.name AS customer, COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers cu
JOIN orders od ON od.customer_id = cu.customer_id AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
JOIN order_lines li ON li.order_id = od.order_id
WHERE cu.name = 'Harbor Pacific'
GROUP BY cu.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS gadget_revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = li.product_id
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE pr.sku = 'GAD-200' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT od.order_id AS order_id, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS amount_cents
FROM orders od
JOIN order_lines li ON li.order_id = od.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-02-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-02-01'
GROUP BY od.order_id
ORDER BY amount_cents DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(re.amount_cents), 0) AS refund_cents
FROM refunds re
WHERE re.refunded_at >= '2026-04-01' AND re.refunded_at < '2026-07-01'

WITH regrev AS (
  SELECT rg.name AS region, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
  FROM order_lines li
  JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
  JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
  JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = cu.region_id
  WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'
  GROUP BY rg.name
)
SELECT region, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC) AS rank_no
FROM regrev

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS september_revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-09-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
  AND cu.region_id = (SELECT c2.region_id FROM customers c2 WHERE c2.name = 'Harbor Pacific')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
WHERE cu.name = 'Northwind Retail' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products pr

WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT od.order_id, cu.region_id,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) FROM order_lines li WHERE li.order_id = od.order_id) AS total_cents
  FROM orders od
  JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
  WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'
)
SELECT rg.name AS region, AVG(po.total_cents) AS avg_order_value_cents
FROM per_order po
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = po.region_id
GROUP BY rg.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS gross_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-04-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-07-01'

SELECT rg.name AS region, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = li.product_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY rg.name

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', od.ordered_at) AS month, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', od.ordered_at)

SELECT pr.sku AS sku, pr.category AS category
FROM products pr

SELECT rg.name AS region, COUNT(cu.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM regions rg
JOIN customers cu ON cu.region_id = rg.region_id
GROUP BY rg.region_id, rg.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders od
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS fytd_revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-11-05'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS amount_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
WHERE cu.name = 'Rhine Goods' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT rg.name AS region, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = li.product_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-05-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-06-01'
GROUP BY rg.name

SELECT CAST((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(re.amount_cents), 0) FROM refunds re
             WHERE re.refunded_at >= '2026-04-01' AND re.refunded_at < '2026-07-01') AS REAL)
     / (SELECT SUM(li.amount_cents)
        FROM order_lines li
        JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
        WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-04-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-07-01') AS refund_share

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = cu.region_id
WHERE rg.name = 'AMER' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-04-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-07-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.qty), 0) AS widget_units
FROM order_lines li
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = li.product_id
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE pr.sku = 'WID-100' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT rg.name AS region, SUM(li.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = od.customer_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = cu.region_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY rg.name
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS widget_revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = li.product_id
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE pr.sku = 'WID-100' AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'

SELECT rg.name AS region,
       COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS october_revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN regions rg ON rg.region_id = li.product_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-10-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY rg.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS billed_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.deleted_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.qty), 0) AS units
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM order_lines li
JOIN orders od ON od.order_id = li.order_id
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS placed_order_count
FROM orders od
WHERE od.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND od.ordered_at < '2027-01-01'
